description: Changes one Notion database view's name, filter, sorts or layout configuration. null clears the filter or the sorts; omitted fields keep their values. A view's type is not changed through Notion's API. Returns the view in the shape notion_create_view returns.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

configuration.description: Notion's view configuration object, sent unchanged.

filter.description: A Notion filter object, sent unchanged. null clears the filter.

name.description: The view's new name, shown on its tab.

sorts.description: A list of Notion property sort objects, sent unchanged. null clears the sorts.

view_id.description: The view's id, or a database URL whose ?v= names the view.

name: notion-mcp__notion_update_view
